items.title: The internal hom complex is well defined up to quasi-isomorphism in both variables

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the internal hom complex is independent of the chosen K-injective representatives in the first variable and of the chosen representative in the second, up to quasi-isomorphism (statement lines 8753-8767). The proof is short but hinges on the representative bookkeeping: one names the objects M and L represented by the two quasi-isomorphic pairs and then invokes the same-chapter description of H^0 of an internal hom into a K-injective complex as the sheafified presheaf U -> Hom_{D(O_U)}(L|_U, M|_U), which is symmetric in the two choices (proof lines 8770-8781). The claim is H2: one identification of two H^0 groups, with no further construction.
